Arhaddāsa
Jain. Dig. pupil of Āśādhara; patronised by Lakṣmaṇa of Mathura, sponsor of Lakṣmaṇotsava 1450 A. D. (Kar. His. Rev. III. 1 an. 2, p.. 1-9).
See also Praśasti Saṁgraha, p.. 30-33, where the date 13th-14th Cent. A. D. is suggested.
--Añjanāpavanañjayanāṭaka. Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 14.
Is Arhaddāsa here a mistake for Hastimalla ?
